  "title": "Two different orders with the same invoice ID",
  "body": "#### Describe the bug

If two different orders are passed at the same time (for my case 3 seconds), the id of the invoice is the same for both orders.
 
I would like to specify that the orders passed before and after these two doesn't have any problem.


#### Expected behavior

The id of the invoice have to be incremented each time a new order is passed.

#### Steps to Reproduce

1. Pass two orders at the same time

**Screenshots**

**TIME :** 

![orders](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/65656961/106028157-e619a500-60cb-11eb-8555-8ff0e4a56d02.PNG)

**ORDER 1:**
![order_1022](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/65656961/106028171-e9149580-60cb-11eb-9b64-22b172c22965.PNG)

**ORDER 2:**

![order_1023](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/65656961/106028175-eade5900-60cb-11eb-9566-5d551bae905f.PNG)

**PDF INVOICE 1 :** 

![pdf_order_1022](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/65656961/106028186-eca81c80-60cb-11eb-89b5-4a6dec88bd40.PNG)

**PDF INVOICE 2:** 

![pdf_order_1023](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/65656961/106028202-f03ba380-60cb-11eb-937e-106b060d3fa4.PNG)


#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version:  1.7.6.4
* PHP version: 7.2.34
",
